fusions.name: Landslide
fusions.desc: Throws your full weight onto the target, which deals 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and is left 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Thunder Pivot
fusions.desc: Swings your weight round in a full circle that deals 15 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gathering Mass
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Blows Banked Up
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 the stacks all spend at once: you roll onto the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
